title: Importing Collections Library
description: Import the Collections library and use Append To List to add items dynamically.

story.setup: MENTOR-9: "BuiltIn library is always available, but Collections library must be imported. Add 'Library    Collections' to your Settings section, then you can use advanced keywords like Append To List."
story.context: Libraries extend Robot Framework's capabilities. Collections provides list/dict manipulation that BuiltIn doesn't have.
story.success: MENTOR-9: "Perfect! You imported Collections and used Append To List to add items dynamically. That's how we extend RF's functionality."

theory.title: Exercise 4.1.1: Importing Libraries
theory.content:
MENTOR-9: "Robot Framework has three types of libraries: BuiltIn (always available), Standard libraries (included but must be imported), and External libraries (installed separately). Collections is a standard library—it ships with RF but needs explicit import."

Library Imports

Use Library setting to import libraries:

*** Settings ***
Library    Collections
Library    String
Library    DateTime

Collections Library Keywords:

  • Append To List: Add items dynamically
  • Remove Values From List: Delete specific values
  • Sort List: Sort alphabetically or numerically
  • Get Slice From List: Extract sub-list
  • List Should Contain Value: Assertion for membership

Example: Building List Dynamically

*** Settings ***
Library    Collections

*** Test Cases ***
Build Component List
    @{components}=    Create List    Engine
    Append To List    ${components}    Navigation    Power
    Log    Components: ${components}
    ${length}=    Get Length    ${components}
    Should Be Equal As Integers    ${length}    3

⚠️ Library Import Rules

  • Import in *** Settings *** section
  • Library names are case-sensitive
  • Standard libraries: Collections, String, DateTime, OperatingSystem
  • Once imported, keywords available in entire file
  • No need to re-import in every test
